title: Orbit Tasks
description: A polished three-column task board with eight sample tasks, priority chips and a compact progress summary.
brief: A polished three-column task board with eight sample tasks, priority chips and a compact progress summary. Add a new task from an input (pre-filled with a sensible task name), move tasks to the next column, and filter by priority. Primary action adds the input task. Reset restores the samples. Use a calm cream and charcoal workspace with cobalt accents.

title: Compound Studio
description: Investment growth calculator with exactly three editable inputs: initial balance1000, annual return5 percent, years10.
brief: Investment growth calculator with exactly three editable inputs: initial balance1000, annual return5 percent, years10. Annual compounding only: once each year set balance = balance * (1 + rate/100). No monthly compounding and no contribution field. Primary Calculate shows final balance, profit and an SVG annual growth chart. Default final balance1628.89; changing initial balance to2000 yields3257.79. Show annual results and the formula. Warm ivory and forest green.

title: Neon Rally
description: A polished single-player paddle-and-ball arcade.
brief: A polished single-player paddle-and-ball arcade. The player moves a bottom paddle with mouse/touch or arrow keys, keeping a ball in play and breaking a small formation of glowing bricks. Primary Play starts; three lives, score, clear win/loss overlay, Reset returns to ready. Use a fixed logical canvas scaled responsively and correct pointer coordinates. Indigo night with coral and cyan. Keep physics simple and reliable.

title: Signal Grid
description: A 3x3 Lights Out puzzle.
brief: A 3x3 Lights Out puzzle. Clicking a cell toggles itself and orthogonal neighbors. Start from a fixed solvable board generated by applying a known sequence of moves to the all-off board. Primary action is Hint, which highlights a cell in a correct solution for the current board; solve the 512 states by BFS if needed. Show moves, lit count, win state and Reset. Swiss-style cream, orange and black; tactile square buttons.

title: Ledger Pocket
description: Expense tracker with seeded transactions, category totals and a small bar chart.
brief: Expense tracker with seeded transactions, category totals and a small bar chart. Primary adds the prefilled expense. Allow deleting a transaction and filtering a category.

title: Field Notes
description: An editorial travel journal with a striking typographic cover, three illustrated destination cards drawn in CSS/SVG, category filters and readable article expansion.
brief: An editorial travel journal with a striking typographic cover, three illustrated destination cards drawn in CSS/SVG, category filters and readable article expansion. Primary opens the featured article.

title: Polarity Panic
description: Build Polarity Panic with a pointer-following magnet and slow drifting plus and minus charges.
brief: Build Polarity Panic with a pointer-following magnet and slow drifting plus and minus charges. Space or click toggles the player's polarity. Matching charges are safe collectibles attracted within a short radius; opposite charges are dangerous and gently repelled, but can still collide if approached too quickly. This is an explicitly fictional arcade rule: show the rule plainly in the instructions. Collect thirty charges within sixty seconds to win; three opposite-charge impacts lose. Keep acceleration capped and make all charges readable by both symbol and color. Use graphite, pink and blue field rings, tiny sparks, and a strong polarity indicator. R restarts.

title: Tempo Focus
description: Pomodoro timer with editable work/break minutes, start/pause, progress ring and completed-session count.
brief: Pomodoro timer with editable work/break minutes, start/pause, progress ring and completed-session count. Primary toggles start/pause; reset cancels the old interval.

title: Copper Coffee
description: A boutique coffee shop website with a beautiful menu, roast filters and a working local order basket.
brief: A boutique coffee shop website with a beautiful menu, roast filters and a working local order basket. Primary adds the featured drink; totals and quantity controls work.

title: Tidekeeper
description: Build Tidekeeper, a side-scrolling boat game where the player changes the sea rather than steering the boat.
brief: Build Tidekeeper, a side-scrolling boat game where the player changes the sea rather than steering the boat. Up/Down or W/S smoothly raises and lowers the waterline; the boat always floats at that height as scenery scrolls left. Alternate underwater rock peaks with hanging cave roofs, leaving generous openings at different heights. A thin preview strip shows the next opening. Pass twelve obstacle pairs to reach the lighthouse and win; hitting rock or roof loses. Show distance progress and R to restart. Use an apricot sky, turquoise water with a subtle wave surface, a tiny paper sailboat, and terracotta caves. Use simple rectangle collisions.

title: Route Weather
description: Offline trip packing planner with three sample destinations and simulated weather clearly labeled.
brief: Offline trip packing planner with three sample destinations and simulated weather clearly labeled. Selecting a destination changes the packing checklist. Primary adds a custom packing item.

title: Northstar Studio
description: An architecture studio portfolio with inline-SVG project illustrations, project filters and a detail panel.
brief: An architecture studio portfolio with inline-SVG project illustrations, project filters and a detail panel. Primary opens the featured project.

title: Echo Diver
description: Build Echo Diver on one fixed top-down underwater map.
brief: Build Echo Diver on one fixed top-down underwater map. Move a yellow submarine with arrows or WASD. Space emits an expanding sonar ring that reveals nearby rocks, mines, pearls, and the exit for a few seconds; only the submarine's small immediate neighborhood remains visible otherwise. Begin with twelve pulses and sixty seconds of oxygen. Retrieve three fixed pearls, then reach the exit to win. Touching a mine or exhausting oxygen loses; rocks simply block movement. Show pearls, pulses, oxygen, and a faint record of collected locations. Use near-black ocean, phosphor-green arcs, and restrained bubbles. Make routes broad and reachable. R restarts.

title: Pantry Ratio
description: Recipe scaler with a seeded pancake recipe.
brief: Recipe scaler with a seeded pancake recipe. Change servings, switch grams/ounces, and calculate accurate scaled quantities. Primary recalculates the ingredient cards.

title: Tidal Museum
description: An ocean science mini-museum with rich SVG exhibits, accessible tabs and a five-question interactive quiz.
brief: An ocean science mini-museum with rich SVG exhibits, accessible tabs and a five-question interactive quiz. Primary starts/advances the quiz with score feedback.

title: Jelly Lens
description: Build Jelly Lens, an automatically scrolling squeeze game.
brief: Build Jelly Lens, an automatically scrolling squeeze game. The jelly stays near the left of the screen; Left/Right or A/D changes its width, and height adjusts inversely so its area stays constant. Clamp both dimensions to sensible minimum and maximum values. Gates alternate between low wide slots and tall narrow slots, with a clear outline showing the approaching aperture. Pass fifteen gates to win; overlapping a gate frame loses. Use forgiving axis-aligned collision boxes and enough advance warning to reshape. Show gates cleared and current shape. Render translucent peach jelly with eyes, plum scenery, cream frames, and satisfying squash easing. R restarts.

title: Palette Lab
description: Color palette designer with five editable colors, contrast ratio against white/black and a live sample UI.
brief: Color palette designer with five editable colors, contrast ratio against white/black and a live sample UI. Primary generates a deterministic new palette; allow locking individual colors.

title: Fable Books
description: An independent bookstore storefront with fictional book covers built from CSS, search/category controls and a basket.
brief: An independent bookstore storefront with fictional book covers built from CSS, search/category controls and a basket. Primary adds the featured book.

title: Neon Fuse
description: Build Neon Fuse on a visible square circuit-board grid.
brief: Build Neon Fuse on a visible square circuit-board grid. A glowing cable moves continuously; arrows or WASD turn its head, with reverse-direction input ignored. Eating an amber battery extends the cable and raises the score. Spawn batteries only on empty cells, and increase speed gently at five-battery intervals. Collect twenty batteries to power the central display and win; hitting a wall or the cable causes a visible short circuit and loses. Show score, next speed step, and R to restart. Use acid-green wire segments, softly lit grid intersections, amber battery symbols, and brief blue solder sparks. Keep collision and input buffering deterministic.

title: Habit Atlas
description: Weekly habit tracker with five habits, seven day toggles, streak summaries and completion chart.
brief: Weekly habit tracker with five habits, seven day toggles, streak summaries and completion chart. Primary completes the next unfinished habit for today.

title: Alpine Lodge
description: A mountain lodge booking demo with scenic CSS/SVG art, room choices, dates/nights and an accurate local booking estimate.
brief: A mountain lodge booking demo with scenic CSS/SVG art, room choices, dates/nights and an accurate local booking estimate. Primary calculates the estimate; clearly a demo, no real booking.

title: Shadow Relay
description: Build Shadow Relay as one small platforming room.
brief: Build Shadow Relay as one small platforming room. Move with arrows or A/D and jump with Space. A translucent shadow follows the player's recorded position from exactly two seconds earlier; it is a playback marker, not a separately simulated body. A broad floor switch opens the exit gate whenever either player or shadow overlaps it. The challenge is to pause on the switch, then run and jump to the exit while the shadow repeats that pause. Add one harmlessly restarting floor gap and generous platform widths. Reaching the open exit wins; falling loses the attempt. Use cream, charcoal, lavender, and vermilion. R resets the room and recording.

title: Invoice Desk
description: Invoice builder with seeded line items, editable quantities/prices, subtotal, tax and total.
brief: Invoice builder with seeded line items, editable quantities/prices, subtotal, tax and total. Primary adds a new line item; allow deletion. All totals recompute correctly.

title: Orbit Launch
description: A space mission explainer with a dramatic orbital SVG, three mission tabs and an interactive launch sequence.
brief: A space mission explainer with a dramatic orbital SVG, three mission tabs and an interactive launch sequence. Primary advances the sequence and updates the timeline.

title: Bubble Shepherd
description: Build Bubble Shepherd in a single aqua aquarium.
brief: Build Bubble Shepherd in a single aqua aquarium. A dozen bubbles drift slowly with damping and slight upward buoyancy. Holding and dragging the pointer creates a visible short current in the drag direction, pushing nearby bubbles; cap the force so steering stays gentle. Guide bubbles into a large portal on the right while avoiding a few fixed purple coral circles. Spawn eighteen bubbles in a short stream; aquarium walls reflect bubbles, except at the portal. Rescue twelve to win; losing five to coral loses. Show rescued and lost counts. Use simple circle collisions, pearly highlights, current streaks, and a gently rotating portal. Never simulate fluid. R restarts with the same clear obstacle layout.

title: Reading Room
description: Personal reading list with seeded books, status tabs, search and progress controls.
brief: Personal reading list with seeded books, status tabs, search and progress controls. Primary adds the prefilled book; moving a book to finished updates statistics.

title: Paper Gallery
description: A digital poster gallery with strong editorial typography, CSS art posters, color filters and a focused detail view.
brief: A digital poster gallery with strong editorial typography, CSS art posters, color filters and a focused detail view. Primary opens the featured poster.

title: Clockwork Climb
description: Build Clockwork Climb as a short vertical platformer inside a copper clock tower.
brief: Build Clockwork Climb as a short vertical platformer inside a copper clock tower. Move with Left/Right or A/D and jump with Space. Ten broad shelves slide horizontally on predictable sine motions; landing carries the player with a shelf. Use one-way platform collisions only while descending. The camera follows upward but does not scroll back down. Reach and touch the bell above shelf ten to win; falling below the visible bottom loses. Show the highest shelf reached and R to restart. Use teal shelves, ivory player, brass rail lines, and huge decorative rotating gears behind the action. Keep jumping generous and omit enemies, ladders, and complex physics.

title: Timezones
description: Meeting planner for New York, London and Tokyo with adjustable UTC hour and correct city time using Intl.DateTimeFormat.
brief: Meeting planner for New York, London and Tokyo with adjustable UTC hour and correct city time using Intl.DateTimeFormat. Primary advances one hour; clearly show day rollover.

title: Saffron Table
description: A modern restaurant site with category menu, dietary filters and a working table/time selection demo.
brief: A modern restaurant site with category menu, dietary filters and a working table/time selection demo. Primary confirms the sample selection locally with visible details.

title: Rocket Gardener
description: Build Rocket Gardener on a small moon with three broad greenhouse landing pads.
brief: Build Rocket Gardener on a small moon with three broad greenhouse landing pads. Left/Right or A/D rotates the rocket; Up, W, or Space applies thrust against simple constant downward gravity. Display a clear speed gauge and landing-angle indicator. A pad accepts the seed only when the rocket is upright enough and descending slowly; after a successful landing, refill some fuel and illuminate the next pad. Plant all three greenhouses to win. Hard ground impact or empty fuel loses. Use generous safe thresholds, circular rocket collision against flat terrain, ink-blue moonlight, coral hull, mint greenhouses, and yellow exhaust particles. R restarts.

title: Budget Envelope
description: Monthly envelope budget with income and editable category allocations.
brief: Monthly envelope budget with income and editable category allocations. Primary applies an entered allocation; remaining balance and bars update accurately.

title: Trail Club
description: Hiking club site with scenic trail cards, difficulty filters and a weekend distance planner.
brief: Hiking club site with scenic trail cards, difficulty filters and a weekend distance planner. Seed three trails and select the first one initially. Clicking any trail must update selectedId and immediately render the selection AND the Add button enabled state. Primary adds the selected trail to the itinerary and recomputes total distance and ascent. Reset restores the sample data and initial selection. Use a single render function after every state-changing handler so the controls cannot become stale.

title: Raincatch Spectrum
description: Build Raincatch Spectrum with one wide umbrella at the bottom and colored drops descending toward it.
brief: Build Raincatch Spectrum with one wide umbrella at the bottom and colored drops descending toward it. Press 1, 2, or 3, or click the three large color pads, to switch the umbrella between cyan, yellow, and pink. A drop scores if the umbrella matches at impact; otherwise it costs a heart. Use one arrival lane and a deterministic, gradually faster sequence with enough spacing to read the next drop. Catch forty drops to win; five mismatches lose. Show score, hearts, and a short upcoming-color queue using symbols as well as colors. Render a charcoal rainy skyline, luminous umbrella, and colored puddle ripples. R restarts.

title: Unit Foundry
description: Unit converter for length, weight and temperature.
brief: Unit converter for length, weight and temperature. Preload a useful conversion. Primary converts; swapping input/output units recalculates accurately.

title: Circuit School
description: An interactive introduction to basic electric circuits using inline SVG and toggles for battery/switch/bulb.
brief: An interactive introduction to basic electric circuits using inline SVG and toggles for battery/switch/bulb. Primary toggles the switch; current flow and explanation update correctly.

title: Ring Runner
description: Build Ring Runner with a white satellite moving around a fixed circular orbit.
brief: Build Ring Runner with a white satellite moving around a fixed circular orbit. Left/Right or A/D rotates it in either direction. Broken rings approach from outside and shrink toward the center; each has one broad angular gap. When a ring crosses the satellite's orbit radius, the satellite must be inside that gap. Use angle wrapping correctly and a forgiving gap margin. Pass twenty-five rings to win; one collision loses. Show rings passed and an arrow marking the next gap. Use ultraviolet tunnel shading, electric-orange ring segments, white trails, and subtle radial star streaks. Start slowly and increase ring speed gently. R restarts.

title: Plant Care
description: Plant care dashboard with six seeded plants, watering intervals and due indicators.
brief: Plant care dashboard with six seeded plants, watering intervals and due indicators. Primary waters the selected plant and updates its real state.

title: Studio Flora
description: A flower shop storefront with CSS/SVG bouquet illustrations, occasion filters and a bouquet builder.
brief: A flower shop storefront with CSS/SVG bouquet illustrations, occasion filters and a bouquet builder. Primary adds a stem type; price and composition update.

title: Blink Decoy
description: Build Blink Decoy in a bounded rectangular arena.
brief: Build Blink Decoy in a bounded rectangular arena. Move with WASD or arrows. A hollow decoy begins across the room; pressing Space exchanges the player's and decoy's positions, with a clearly shown one-second cooldown. Edge cannons briefly draw a pale targeting line at the player's current position, then fire a straight slow shot along that locked line. At forty seconds, win with eight collected energy cells or lose without them; three hits also lose. Spawn cells on open ground and keep projectile counts modest. Use a cyan player, amber decoy, black-and-red arena, teleport afterimages, and readable warning lines. R restarts. Do not add shooting or enemy movement.

title: Workout Deck
description: Workout session planner with six sample exercises, editable sets/reps and a session timer.
brief: Workout session planner with six sample exercises, editable sets/reps and a session timer. Primary adds the selected exercise; remove and reorder exercises.

title: Redline Motors
description: A fictional bicycle showroom with SVG bicycle illustrations, model comparison and option controls.
brief: A fictional bicycle showroom with SVG bicycle illustrations, model comparison and option controls. Primary adds the selected bike to comparison; no external photos.

title: Lamps of Europa
description: Build Lamps of Europa, a 5×5 lights-out puzzle in an icy moon observatory.
brief: Build Lamps of Europa, a 5×5 lights-out puzzle in an icy moon observatory. Clicking a lamp toggles it and its orthogonal neighbors. The goal is to turn every lamp off within thirty moves; reaching zero lit lamps wins, and exhausting moves loses. Create a guaranteed-solvable opening by applying eight to twelve recorded legal toggles to an all-off board, rather than assigning random lamp states. Display remaining moves, lit-lamp count, and a clear hover preview of affected cells. Use warm amber lamps, navy metal panels, pale ice edges, and slow decorative snow motes. R restores the same starting puzzle. Omit additional levels or puzzle variants.

title: Markdown Pocket
description: Live markdown notes editor supporting headings, bold, lists and code blocks without external libraries.
brief: Live markdown notes editor supporting headings, bold, lists and code blocks without external libraries. Seed a useful note. Primary inserts a new section; preview updates and user input is escaped safely.

title: Small Observatory
description: A night-sky guide with a CSS/SVG star map, constellation toggles and an interactive planet fact panel.
brief: A night-sky guide with a CSS/SVG star map, constellation toggles and an interactive planet fact panel. Primary highlights the next constellation.

title: Ink Archipelago
description: Build Ink Archipelago as an 8×8 flood-fill board with five clearly distinct jewel colors.
brief: Build Ink Archipelago as an 8×8 flood-fill board with five clearly distinct jewel colors. Start from the top-left cell. Clicking a palette button recolors the entire connected home region and absorbs all orthogonally adjacent cells of the chosen color. Fill the board within twenty-two moves to win; running out of moves loses. Use a fixed small board or generate a board whose simple greedy solution fits the limit, and keep a visible outline around the owned region. Display owned cells and moves left. Animate the color spreading briefly, without delaying input. Use cream paper, dark coastlines, and jewel-tone islands. R restarts the same board.

title: Schedule Studio
description: Daily appointment planner with a time grid and seeded appointments.
brief: Daily appointment planner with a time grid and seeded appointments. Primary adds an appointment from prefilled fields; detect time conflicts and allow deleting appointments.

title: Sunday Market
description: A farmers market directory with vendor filters, product cards and a shopping list.
brief: A farmers market directory with vendor filters, product cards and a shopping list. Primary adds the featured product; quantities and estimated totals work.

title: Folded Signal
description: Build Folded Signal on a 5×5 optical bench.
brief: Build Folded Signal on a 5×5 optical bench. A beam enters from the left of row two; clickable diagonal mirrors toggle between slash and backslash and reflect the beam by ninety degrees. Use four fixed mirrors that can form a clear bent route to a receiver on the right edge, plus one optional harmless decoy. Construct the solved route first, then flip selected mirrors to create the puzzle. Trace the beam cell by cell with a strict step cap so loops cannot hang. Light the receiver within sixteen flips to win; exhausting flips loses. Use smoky violet, gold light, chrome mirrors, and green success bloom. R restarts.

title: Split Table
description: Restaurant bill splitter with bill, tip percentage and people count.
brief: Restaurant bill splitter with bill, tip percentage and people count. Primary calculates exact per-person share, tip and total, with sensible validation.

title: Type Archive
description: A typography specimen site using system serif/sans/mono fonts, size/weight sliders and editable sample text.
brief: A typography specimen site using system serif/sans/mono fonts, size/weight sliders and editable sample text. Primary cycles the specimen layout and preserves the edited text.

title: Gravity Vault
description: Build Gravity Vault as one compact Sokoban-style puzzle: the player moves on a 7×7 orthogonal grid and can push one copper cube at a time, but cannot pull or push two cubes together.
brief: Build Gravity Vault as one compact Sokoban-style puzzle: the player moves on a 7×7 orthogonal grid and can push one copper cube at a time, but cannot pull or push two cubes together. Use a hand-designed, verified-solvable room with three cubes, three turquoise sockets, broad corridors, and a few meaningful walls. Filling all sockets within sixty moves wins; exhausting moves loses. Show moves and filled sockets. Include U to undo the last move because corner traps are part of the puzzle, and R to reset. Render slate tiles with beveled edges and offset shadows for a dimensional look. Do not implement real gravity or multiple levels.

title: Sprint Board
description: Project sprint estimator with seeded tasks, point values and a capacity gauge.
brief: Project sprint estimator with seeded tasks, point values and a capacity gauge. Primary adds a task; allow toggling completion and changing capacity.

title: Savings Map
description: Savings goal planner with three seeded goals and progress rings.
brief: Savings goal planner with three seeded goals and progress rings. Primary deposits the entered amount into the selected goal; recompute remaining amount and completion.

title: Music Queue
description: Offline playlist organizer with seeded fictional tracks, duration totals, mood filters and reorder controls.
brief: Offline playlist organizer with seeded fictional tracks, duration totals, mood filters and reorder controls. Primary adds a selected sample track. Do not claim audio playback.

title: Seat Picker
description: Small theater seat reservation demo with available/booked/selected states and prices.
brief: Small theater seat reservation demo with available/booked/selected states and prices. Primary confirms current preselected seats, updating availability and total.

title: Garden Plot
description: Interactive 6x6 garden planner with selectable crop types, planting cells and a crop-count summary.
brief: Interactive 6x6 garden planner with selectable crop types, planting cells and a crop-count summary. Primary plants the selected crop in the next empty cell.

title: Recipe Index
description: Searchable recipe collection with category tabs, favorite toggles and expandable ingredient views.
brief: Searchable recipe collection with category tabs, favorite toggles and expandable ingredient views. Primary favorites the selected recipe, updating the favorites count.

title: Word Workshop
description: Writing tool with a seeded text editor, word/character/sentence counts and reading-time estimate.
brief: Writing tool with a seeded text editor, word/character/sentence counts and reading-time estimate. Primary removes duplicate spaces and recomputes statistics.

title: Stockroom
description: Inventory dashboard with twelve fictional items, search, low-stock filter and quantity controls.
brief: Inventory dashboard with twelve fictional items, search, low-stock filter and quantity controls. Primary receives the entered quantity for a selected item.

title: Travel Budget
description: Trip cost calculator with transport, nights, nightly rate, food/day and people.
brief: Trip cost calculator with transport, nights, nightly rate, food/day and people. Primary calculates total and per-person share with a category chart.

title: Memory Journal
description: Daily mood journal with seeded entries, date/mood inputs and a weekly mood chart.
brief: Daily mood journal with seeded entries, date/mood inputs and a weekly mood chart. Primary saves a new entry; entries can be filtered and deleted.

title: Grid Composer
description: CSS grid layout designer with column/gap sliders and colored sample panels.
brief: CSS grid layout designer with column/gap sliders and colored sample panels. Primary adds a panel; live preview and CSS text update.

title: Decision Matrix
description: Weighted decision matrix with three options and three criteria.
brief: Weighted decision matrix with three options and three criteria. Render all nine editable score fields and three weight fields. Store scores as a 3x3 array and index by option row and criterion column. For each option calculate sum(weight[j]*score[i][j]) / sum(weights), then rank descending; if total weight iszero, show validation. Doubling every weight must leave normalized totals unchanged. Seed distinct values; Primary Calculate recomputes all totals and ranking. Reset restores all nine scores and three weights. Keep the entire matrix visible at960x600.
